ruleDefinitions.name: Use of W32tm as Timer
ruleDefinitions.description: When configured with suitable command line arguments, w32tm can act as a delay mechanism

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\w32tm\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "w32time\.dll") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/stripchart.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/computer\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/period\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/dataonly.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/samples\\:.*")))
